roots.origin: 拉丁语 habitare（居住、常驻），是 habere（持有）的反复体：反复持有某地 → 住下
roots.core_concept: to dwell, to hold a place as one's own / 长期驻留某处、把某处据为己居
roots.core_image: 鸟在同一个巢里年复一年回来住下

roots.origin: 拉丁语 punctum（刺出的点、小孔），来自 pungere（刺）的过去分词 punctus
roots.core_concept: a sharp point, a single marked spot / 一个尖锐的顶端或一个单独标记的点
roots.core_image: 针尖在纸上刺出一个小孔——又尖又小、位置精确

roots.origin: 拉丁语 limes（边界、田界），limitis 的属格 → 英语 limit
roots.core_concept: a boundary line, the edge beyond which something may not go / 一条边界线，越线即被禁止
roots.core_image: 田地尽头的一道界桩，牛走到那儿就停下不再往前

roots.origin: 希腊语 kybernan（掌舵）经拉丁语 gubernare（驾驶、指挥）传入，控制论的 cybernetics 同源
roots.core_concept: to steer a ship, to direct and control / 掌舵引航、把握方向实施掌控
roots.core_image: 舵手站在船尾把住舵轮，船按他定的方向前行

concepts.concept: to dwell in a place, to keep returning to it
concepts.core_image: 同一只鸟年复一年回到同一个巢里住下

concepts.concept: a sharp point or a single precise spot
concepts.core_image: 针尖刺纸留下一个精准的小孔

concepts.concept: the boundary edge beyond which one may not pass
concepts.core_image: 田边的界桩挡住牛不再往前走

concepts.concept: to steer and direct, holding the course
concepts.core_image: 舵手把住舵轮，让船按定好的方向走

words.root_logic: habit（居住/反复持有）→ 反复做的动作像反复住同一个地方一样固定下来
words.origin: 拉丁语 habitus（状态、习惯），来自 habere（持有）的反复体 habitare（居住）
words.native_definition: a settled regular practice, especially one hard to give up
words.core_concept: a practice one returns to as steadily as returning home – 像反复回到老住处一样稳定反复的做法
words.core_image: 同一条路每天清晨都走一遍，脚自己就知道往哪拐
examples: He has a habit of reading before bed.
Smoking is a hard habit to break.
semantic_expansions: 习惯/习性：反复做、像常驻一样稳定的行为方式
words.recall_hint: habit（居住）→ 反复回到同一处住下 → 反复做的动作固定成习惯

words.root_logic: in-（在内）+ habit（居住）→ 在某个地方里边住着
words.origin: 拉丁语 inhabitare（居住于），来自 in＋habitare
words.native_definition: to live or dwell in a place
words.core_concept: dwelling inside a place as its resident – 作为居者住在某地之内
words.core_image: 一家人搬进山谷里的小屋，从此长期住下
examples: These birds inhabit the coastal cliffs.
Thousands of species inhabit the reef.
semantic_expansions: 居住于/栖息于：作为居民长期住在某处
words.recall_hint: in-（在内）+ habit（居住）→ 住在某处里面

words.root_logic: in-（在内）+ habit（居住）+ -ant（人）→ 住在里面的人
words.origin: 拉丁语 inhabitans（居住的），来自 inhabitare（居住于）
words.native_definition: a person or animal that lives in a particular place
words.core_concept: one who dwells inside a place – 住在某地之内的人或生物
words.core_image: 山谷小屋的窗户里透出灯光，屋主一家常年住在那里
examples: The island's inhabitants rely on fishing.
Ancient inhabitants left stone circles here.
semantic_expansions: 居民/住户：长期居住在某地的成员
words.recall_hint: in-（在内）+ habit（居住）+ -ant（人）→ 住在此地的人

words.root_logic: point（刺出的点）→ 尖端、要点；动词指把注意力指向某一点
words.origin: 古法语 point（点），来自拉丁语 punctum（刺出的点）
words.native_definition: a sharp end, a particular spot, or the main idea; to direct attention to something
words.core_concept: the exact spot marked by a prick, sharp and precise – 被刺出的那个精准位置，尖而确定
words.core_image: 箭头的尖稳稳扎在靶心那一个点上
examples: The pencil has a sharp point.
Good point—let me reconsider.
She pointed at the map.
semantic_expansions: 点/尖端：刺出的尖锐位置
要点：众多话里被'点'出的核心一处
指向：把注意力引到某个点上
words.recall_hint: point（刺出的点）→ 靶尖那样精确的一处；话里的'点'即被指出要点

words.root_logic: ap-（ad- 靠向）+ point（点）→ 把某人'点'定到某个职位上
words.origin: 古法语 apointier（安排到位），来自拉丁语 ad＋punctum（点到）
words.native_definition: to choose someone for a position, or fix a time for something
words.core_concept: marking someone out to a post, or fixing a moment – 把某人点定为职位人选，或把时间定于某刻
words.core_image: 校长在名单上点出一个名字，指定他担任组长
examples: They appointed her to lead the team.
The meeting was appointed for Monday.
semantic_expansions: 任命/指派：把人点定到某个职位
约定：把时间点定为某刻
words.recall_hint: ap-（靠向）+ point（点）→ 把人点到某个职位上

words.root_logic: appoint（任命/约定）+ -ment（名词）→ 任命这件事，或约好的相会时刻
words.origin: 古法语 apointement（安排），来自 apointier（安排到位）
words.native_definition: an arrangement to meet at a set time, or the act of choosing someone for a post
words.core_concept: a fixed meeting moment, or the assigned post itself – 定好的相会时刻，或已被点定的职位
words.core_image: 日历上画着圈的那格时间，就是和牙医约好的就诊时刻
examples: I have a dentist appointment at three.
Her appointment as director was announced.
semantic_expansions: 预约/约定：定好的会面时刻
任命：被点定担任的职位
words.recall_hint: appoint（点定）+ -ment → 点定的时刻或职位

words.root_logic: limit（边界）→ 不许越过的边界；动词是给某物划下边界
words.origin: 拉丁语 limes（边界），经古法语 limite 入英语
words.native_definition: a point or line beyond which something does not or may not extend; to set such a line
words.core_concept: the boundary line one may not cross – 不允许越过的那条边界线
words.core_image: 跑道上画着终点线，冲过那根线比赛就结束
examples: There is a limit to what we can do.
Please limit your speech to five minutes.
semantic_expansions: 限度/界限：不许越过的那条边界
限制：为事物划下边界
words.recall_hint: limit（边界）→ 不许越过的线；划线即限制

words.root_logic: limit（边界）+ -ation（名词）→ 边界的存在本身，即受限制的状态
words.origin: 拉丁语 limitatio（划定边界），来自 limitare（划界）
words.native_definition: a restriction, or a weakness that restricts what someone can do
words.core_concept: the state of having a boundary drawn around one – 被划在边界内、无法越出的状态
words.core_image: 笼子再大也有边框，飞禽的活动范围到此为止
examples: The main limitation is the budget.
He knows his own limitations.
semantic_expansions: 限制/局限：被边界框住的状态
缺陷：能力被边界框住的部分
words.recall_hint: limit（边界）+ -ation → 被边界框住的状态

words.root_logic: limit（边界）+ -ed（已…的）→ 已被划下边界、范围不大的
words.native_definition: restricted in size, amount, or extent; not very large
words.core_concept: having a boundary drawn around it, small in reach – 被边界圈住、伸展余地不大
words.core_image: 一小块圈起来的实验田，只种得下几种作物
examples: The offer is available for a limited time.
His knowledge of the subject is limited.
semantic_expansions: 有限的：被边界圈住、范围不大
words.recall_hint: limit（边界）+ -ed → 被边界圈定的、范围有限

words.root_logic: govern（掌舵）→ 像舵手把握方向一样管理众人事务
words.origin: 古法语 governer，来自拉丁语 gubernare（驾驶、指挥）
words.native_definition: to control and direct a country, group, or activity
words.core_concept: steering a vessel of people along a chosen course – 像把舵一样引导众人沿既定方向行进
words.core_image: 船长端坐驾驶台，轮船按他给出的航线破浪前行
examples: The council governs the town.
Prices are governed by supply and demand.
semantic_expansions: 统治/治理：像掌舵一样把握方向管理事务
支配：规律像舵一样主导结果
words.recall_hint: govern（掌舵）→ 把握方向 → 治理一方事务

words.root_logic: govern（治理）+ -ment（名词）→ 治理一国的机构整体
words.origin: 古法语 governement（管理），来自 governer（治理）
words.native_definition: the group of people who rule a country or state
words.core_concept: the steering apparatus of a whole nation – 为整个国家把舵的那套机构
words.core_image: 议会大楼里的人们开会定策，相当于给国家掌舵的那套装置
examples: The government announced new policies.
She works for the local government.
semantic_expansions: 政府/政体：治理一国的机构整体
words.recall_hint: govern（治理）+ -ment → 治理国家的机构

words.root_logic: govern（治理）+ -or（人）→ 掌舵的人 → 一方之长
words.origin: 古法语 gouvreneur，来自拉丁语 gubernator（舵手、指挥者）
words.native_definition: the head of a state, region, or institution
words.core_concept: the person at the helm of a region or body – 为某地区或机构把舵的人
words.core_image: 楼顶旗帜猎猎，坐在主位的那人统筹着全州大小事务
examples: The governor signed the new law.
He was elected governor last year.
semantic_expansions: 州长/总督：为一方把舵的首脑
words.recall_hint: govern（治理）+ -or（人）→ 为一方掌舵的人

words.root_logic: fact（做→已做成）→ 已经做成、不会改变的事 → 事实
words.origin: 拉丁语 factum（已做成的事），facere（做）的过去分词中性形式
words.native_definition: something known to be true, especially something that can be proved
words.core_concept: a thing already done and fixed, standing firm – 已经做成、定型不变之物
words.core_image: 石碑上刻下的那行字，任谁来看都是不动的实情
examples: The fact is that we were late.
Facts speak louder than words.
semantic_expansions: 事实：已成定局、不再改变的事
（法律）既成事实 → 真相
words.recall_hint: fac（做）+ 过去分词 → 已经做成的、定型之事 → 事实

words.root_logic: fact（已做成的）+ -or（做…者）→ 参与做成某事的一个成分
words.origin: 拉丁语 factor（制造者），来自 facere（做）
words.native_definition: one of the things that helps produce a result; a number that divides another exactly
words.core_concept: one of the doers that together make a result – 合力造成某一结果的各个成分之一
words.core_image: 烹调的几味调料缺一不可，缺一味味道就变
examples: Cost is a major factor in the decision.
Two and three are factors of six.
semantic_expansions: 因素/要素：共同造成结果的一个成分
因子：把某数'做成'其整数倍的成分
words.recall_hint: fact（做）+ -or（者）→ 参与做成结果的成分

words.root_logic: fact（做）+ -ory（场所）→ 专门做东西的场所
words.origin: 拉丁语 factoria（工场），来自 factor（制造者）
words.native_definition: a building where goods are made in large quantities
words.core_concept: a place where making happens at scale – 大批量'做'东西的场所
words.core_image: 厂房里流水线不停转动，商品一件件被做出来
examples: The factory employs five hundred workers.
Cars roll off the factory line daily.
semantic_expansions: 工厂：专门大批量制造物品的场所
words.recall_hint: fact（做）+ -ory（场所）→ 做东西的地方
